claims.statement: Replay executed before pickup slots were corrected; orders re-booked into closed (expired) slots and remain held. This confirms m8_r_owner precondition: 'Replaying held allocations is safe only after their pickup slots have been corrected.'

Root cause fully established: Carrier partition 2 (east-node) feed consumer stopped at 05:58, 47 minutes behind. Slots booked against stale data. EXC-0921 orders have expired windows. Slot correction cannot proceed while consumer is stuck; consumer restart is required precondition for correcting partition 2 slots.

Partition 2 feed consumer restart is a platform/infrastructure action outside incident assessor authority (requires DevOps or Carrier Operations backend access per m8_e07). Mitigation blocked until external team resumes consumer.

next_action.rationale: Root cause: Partition 2 feed consumer stuck at 05:58. Mitigation path clear (resume consumer → correct slots → replay allocations) but consumer restart is outside incident assessor authority per m8_e07. Escalate to Carrier Operations / DevOps to restart partition 2 feed consumer. Once resumed, apply_slot_correction and replay_held_allocations will succeed (verified by re-booking evidence in m8_r_handoffs). This is the highest-information next step within authority boundary.
